name: devbook-collaboration
description: Review, comment, and hand-off workflows over devbook chapters. Hands a chapter to a reviewer with a brief, reviews one — or a whole change, its proposal and every delta — against its folder's rules and its evidence, records each finding as a devbook annotation fence beside the passage it is about, runs the approval decision that writes devbook's own approved rung, runs the acceptance decision that writes the accepted rung above it — on a change, once on its proposal — and sweeps the adopted folders and open changes for open notes, work awaiting a decision, and approvals gone stale. Five skills and the read-only script the queue runs on, over devbook: a review in progress is the chapter's status and its open annotation fences, who owes the next move stays in the pull request or the tracker, and the only fields it writes are devbook's approval and acceptance rungs, all validated by the check, so it owns no schema, materializes nothing into a repository, and stamps nothing.
